location_exception_reason: Mist chambers are prefabricated structures with standardised design and function; buyer decision is driven by specifications (frame type, covering material, misting system, size), not geographic origin. Location in title adds no product intelligence.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Dealer') in mist chamber titles are redundant — IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Mist Chamber Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product description; the business relationship is not part of what is being sold.
